<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at v0.22.0-beta -->

## What's Changed
### New Features
* feat: Add shared memory (tmpfs) tracking to diagnostics by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/14
* feat: Show changelog modal before update by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/19
### Bug Fixes
* fix: Use packet PTS for timestamp detection (FFmpeg 4.x compatibility) by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/13
* fix: Handle counter resets in frame drop calculations by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/16
* fix: Prevent spurious "Stream unavailable" message during camera startup by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/17
* fix: Add confirmation dialog for clip deletion by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/18
* fix(ci): Add alpha tag and fix empty release notes by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/20
### Other Changes
* feat: Add memory and segments monitoring to diagnostics panel by @liamgallagher in https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/pull/15


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/liamgallagher/echolab/compare/v0.21.1-beta...v0.22.0-beta
